userProfile.title: User Profile
userProfile.description: Secure user account and preference profile data.

uid.description: The unique Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

email.description: The user's verified or primary email address.

photoURL.description: URL to the user's avatar image.

bio.description: Short user bio or AI personalization preference.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the user account was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

isBolexPlus.description: Whether the user holds an active Bolex Plus subscription tier.

planTier.description: The current subscription tier (free or plus).

/users/{userId}.description: Stores private user account information. Only readable and writable by the user whose UID matches the document ID.
